semanticAssessment.result: Saved event zone and displayed zone remain distinct. Device-zone fallback is conditional. Reopening and checking actual booking precedes moving the event.
Apple Time Zone/Time Zone Override remain Apple Calendar controls; no extension to Cloud behavior asserted. Google computer editor controls remain Google-specific.
Independent start/end zones depend on explicit editor support; provider-editor fallback remains conditional. Notes containing a city do not establish the saved time-zone field.
Seasonal changes checked near each participant’s clock change and next occurrence. No fixed year-round offset; all-day labels do not replace timed deadlines.

Imported snapshot and subscribed source remain distinct. Compare source/recipient event and display zones before altering original. Feed-format problems are only one possibility, no automatic repair or authorized-account replacement promised.

languageAssessment: Natural, complete Bulgarian with appropriate formal plural address and clear practical examples. Technical terms are understandable; unchanged English UI names avoid fabricated localized controls. No language issue requires a revision.
